subject.title: fix(ui): keep the sidebar run indicator on the left

question: Should maintainers accept the shared leading-glyph visual treatment after reviewing an after-fix capture across the supported sidebar icon shapes?
rationale: The protected `maintainer` label prevents automated cleanup, and visual clarity of scaled square artwork is a product-facing UI judgment that static tests do not fully settle.

options.title: Review with visual evidence
options.body: Request or inspect a redacted before/after capture of Home, pinned pages, and threaded rows, then merge if the shared indicator column is legible.

options.title: Keep the existing split treatment
options.body: Reject the visual consolidation if maintainers prefer page-state indicators at the trailing edge rather than around page artwork.

recommendation.title: Review with visual evidence
recommendation.body: Request or inspect a redacted before/after capture of Home, pinned pages, and threaded rows, then merge if the shared indicator column is legible.
